guide_q: how does proof of work stop a double-spend?
note: guide_q / agent / root: questions the page test asks the guide and one agent; chapter-specific, so the test can check that the guide hands over to the right agent. The Consensus agent covers six concepts of the ontology at version 1.2.0 and four of them have an executed example (proof of work, the double-spend, mining and the difficulty adjustment), so a follow-up asking for an example can be answered, and it is not the largest agent (Computing with 13 concepts, Transfer with 11 and Cryptography with 9 are larger), which the test uses for its earlier questions. The three remaining switches say what SEN0401 does not (yet) have, so the checks that need it are skipped and listed rather than failed: corpus_kinds = the kinds of passage the agents search (no textbook or course ontology); course_outcomes = a course ontology with LO-n outcomes; code_layers = concept examples that are Python programs (ontology graph syntax and behaviour layers). bank_complete is no longer set to false: question_bank_v1_1_0.json has an item for each of the 117 concepts, two for each of the 42 concepts with a worked example, and question_bank_check_v1_2_0.py reports PASS.
